business_rules: Only Operations users are assigned to departments
Branch-scoped roles (Receptionist, Center Coordinator) cannot have department assignments
Other roles (Director, Admin, etc.) are not assigned to departments
Department names must be unique within a company
Departments cannot be hard deleted if users are assigned to them
Department assignments are mutually exclusive with branch assignments
